description: F0011米崙斷層活動斷層地質敏感區劃定計畫書 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. 米崙斷層活動斷層地質敏感區劃定計劃書書圖資料，主要描述其地質描述、斷層長度、敏感區影響鄉鎮等相關資訊。 本地質敏感區範圍已於109年4月28日修正更新為「活動斷層地質敏感區(F1011米崙斷層)」，相關資訊請洽以下本所官網下載 gsmma. gov. tw/laws/detail? id=973c732... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部地質調查及礦業管理中心. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-08-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
